notes: noReminder = no card in cards[] and no scan row prints a reminder that DEFINES the keyword. Glimpse reminders use cache/recycle without defining them; Reconfigure and Amphivore/Lost Guardian print partial Augment/Graft reminders (listed, rules 721/722) that do not define the mechanic. Burst spell tokens (Crystal, Fireball, Poison) print no reminder. Manual p.13/p.15/p.32-35/p.40-41 and Rulebook 2023 p.3-4/p.15-16 define Haste, Battle, Virus, Burst, Augment, Graft, Unstable (modded), Ambush, Sacrifice in prose.

noReminderInCardsArrayAlone: these 10 attributes print their reminder on the type line only; the quotes come from client/ui/scan-reminders.json (read off the scans by eye 2026-09-05), not from cards[].

Rulebook 2023 is the older edition: "main phase"/"mana step"/"Mana Converters"/"Threshold"/"health"/"discard" = deployment/resource step/Prismites/affinity/defense/bin; p.12 names a "Ranged" attribute (deal combat damage first and block fliers) that is not in the current Attr list (mapped to 802.4 Swift and 802.2 Flying). p.6 says players draw 2 "on every turn after the first", and constructed players "draw 4 cards, then select 2" for the bottom.
801 and 803 sub-numbers are ledger-allocated, so keyword actions/abilities carry the parent rule only. Attr numbers are 802.(index in enums.attrs + 2).
